name: Grilled Chicken Burger with Raspberry BBQ Sauce, Asparagus & Peppers

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ oranges
3 (170 g) pkgs raspberries
3 red bell peppers
3 small bunches asparagus

instructions.primary_message: Peel garlic; add to the blender with the orange juice along with raspberries, ketchup, sugar, Worcestershire, and spices. Blend on high until BBQ sauce is very smooth,1-2 minutes; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
⅓ cup ketchup
2 tbsp brown sugar
1 ½ tsp Worcestershire sauce
¾ tsp cumin, ground
½ tsp chili powder
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

While the grill pan heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg chicken breasts, boneless skinless
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil; working in batches if necessary, add chicken and grill until charred and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, trim, halve, seed, and slice bell peppers crosswise into 1-inch wide strips; place in a large bowl.
Snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Peel, halve, and slice onions lengthwise into ½-inch thick wedges; add to the bowl. Drizzle veggies with oil, season with salt and pepper, then gently toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium red onions
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the chicken is done, working in batches if necessary, add veggies to the pan; grill, flipping once, until tender, 2-3 minutes per side. Return to the bowl.

To assemble the burgers, spread 1 tablespoon of BBQ sauce over the bottom half of each bun; top with chicken and another 1 tablespoon of the sauce. Close with the top half of each bun. (Reserve remaining sauce for serving.)
Divide burgers and grilled veggies between plates; serve with remaining sauce on the side for dipping. Enjoy!
